Subject: Take-home: systems mini-project + sandbox access (submission & reviewer plan)

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with us last week — the team enjoyed meeting you. As discussed, attached is a short take-home mini-project that mirrors a small part of the work we do on the serving runtime. The goal is to see your design tradeoffs and engineering clarity, not to write a production system.

What’s included:
- design_prompt.pdf (attached): description, constraints, success criteria, and suggested deliverables.
- evaluation_rubric.xlsx (attached): what reviewers will look for.
- Sandbox repo: a lightweight starter repo and Dockerfile (link below).

Logistics:
- Deadline: 5 business days from receipt (Fri, Sep 3 by 11:59 PM PT). If you need an extension, let us know — we’re flexible.
- Submission: ZIP of your project or a link to a public GitHub repo + README, reply to this thread.
- Runtime: we provide a CodeSandbox instance if you want to run code without local setup — see the sandbox invite link below.

Next steps on our side: I’m looping in Marissa and Logan to coordinate reviewer coverage and schedule the debrief once you submit. Expect a 60–75 minute panel debrief with at least two reviewers (one technical, one systems).

Links & attachments:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-takehome-EL-342
- Sandbox invite: https://codesandbox.io/s/redwood-tn-elena-342 (invitation will be sent separately from CodeSandbox)
- Attachments: design_prompt.pdf, evaluation_rubric.xlsx

Please reply to confirm you received the materials and if the deadline works for you. If you prefer to schedule a quick sync to walk through the prompt, I can offer 20-minute slots tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Recruiter, Engineering Hiring | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs:
- design_prompt.pdf (application/pdf)
- evaluation_rubric.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Hi Elena — quick answers inline.

The telemetry sample is synthetic and is available in the Drive folder under /datasets/sample_telemetry.csv. We provide it so you don't have to generate anything from scratch; feel free to augment it if you want to show additional analysis.

I resent the Codesandbox invite (CodeSandbox will send from sandbox@codesandbox.io) — can you confirm you see that once it arrives? If not, we’ll fallback to a temporary GitHub Codespaces link.

Also cc’ing Marissa and Logan so they can start penciling reviewer slots. Marissa — can you and Logan cover reviews next week? If we get Elena’s submission by Sep 3 end of day, I’m aiming to run debriefs Sep 6–8 (windows below).

Possible debrief windows (PT):
- Tue, Sep 6: 10:00–12:30 or 14:00–16:30
- Wed, Sep 7: 09:30–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Thu, Sep 8: 11:00–14:00

Primary asks for reviewers: be prepared to discuss design tradeoffs, complexity/costs, and potential productionization steps. It’s a practical convo, not a perf test.

Thanks — Soojin
